description.value: Rusty Iron Coffee Co. is a community-oriented coffee shop in 108 Mile Ranch run by co-owners Ryan and Nathania, built around the philosophy that good coffee brings people together. The café offers a full menu of specialty espresso drinks, iced beverages, breakfast and lunch wraps, and housemade baked goods, sourcing beans from Smoking Gun Coffee Roasters in Abbotsford. Cyclists travelling the Cariboo corridor will find a welcoming, wheelchair-accessible stop for hot or cold drinks, light meals, and branded merchandise including retail coffee beans and insulated mugs.
